races.race_name: Winning Experience With Moulton Racing Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Allegrino
runners.spotlight: Ridden more patiently than usual on her turf debut last time, back from a break, and she was inclined to pull hard (also hung left, not for the first time); that was a fair effort all things considered and she's a major player.
runners.comment: Fair turf debut recently all things considered and she's a major player

runners.name: Dream Illusion
runners.spotlight: Four-time Tapeta winner, including three times this year, all off lower marks; turned in a career best on turf five weeks ago (7f, good to firm) and holds claims on that for a yard among the winners.
runners.comment: Career best on turf five weeks ago and holds claims on that for a yard among the winners

runners.name: Lovers Leap
runners.spotlight: Found a weak maiden when off the mark at long odds-on in May and is better judged on her latest handicap debut effort; cheekpieces come off for a trainer bang among the winners and this filly is one to consider under Billy Loughnane (7-40 for the yard).
runners.comment: Cheekpieces come off for a trainer bang among the winners; one to consider

runners.name: Ironist
runners.spotlight: Second in this race last year off a 2lb lower mark; yard has been struggling for winners, while some rain would have been optimal, but she does like it here and should fare better than when favourite at Kempton early last week.
runners.comment: Second in this race last year off a 2lb lower mark; should fare better back round here

runners.name: Galileo Charm
runners.spotlight: Plenty of racing now and she will need to improve on her two turf efforts in the spring, now back down in trip returning from a short break; others have more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Plenty of racing now and she will need to improve on her two turf efforts in the spring

runners.name: Angels' Share
runners.spotlight: Two Polytrack wins late last summer were far better than any of her turf efforts; the handicapper's proving quick to ease off but she's hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Handicapper's proving quick to ease off but she's hard to fancy

runners.name: Izzy Fast
runners.spotlight: Maiden win here (6f) on comeback in the spring, when 50-1, reads well enough; she's struggled badly in two handicaps since, however, and will need to settle better back up from sprint trips; has it all to prove now.
runners.comment: Struggled badly in two runs in handicaps since 50-1 win in a 6f maiden here in the spring

runners.name: Fantasy Obsessor
runners.spotlight: Won a novice this time last year over (an easy) 7f round Chelmsford but has done most racing since in sprints, latterly when second in a small field here (6f) 12 days ago; will need to settle better than has often been the case.
runners.comment: Seen mostly in sprints; will need to settle better than has often been the case

races.race_name: Infobond Nursery Handicap

runners.name: My Maria
runners.spotlight: Plenty went wrong on her debut and she was again inclined to edge left on soft ground last time; this half-sister to two 2yo winners should have more to offer off what looks a fair opening mark.
runners.comment: Plenty went wrong on debut; should have more to offer off what looks a fair opening mark

runners.name: Holi Scarlett
runners.spotlight: Trainer won with four of his last eight runners, including this filly at Nottingham last Thursday; she doesn't look particularly well in under a 6lb penalty but she may have more to offer under William Buick (2-14 for the yard).
runners.comment: Trainer won with four of his last eight runners; may have more to offer under a penalty

runners.name: Or Another
runners.spotlight: Short price on his debut in the spring, when third of four, before again running below market expectations next time; evidently felt capable of better and is one to consider now handicapping in first-time headgear having been gelded.
runners.comment: One to consider now handicapping in first-time headgear having been gelded

runners.name: Fly Test
runners.spotlight: Well supported at Windsor a month ago, only to blow the start, but was more professional latest, having been gelded; it's hard to know the merits of that run as yet for a trainer whose strike-rate is down with 2yos this season, but it was a decent forward step.
runners.comment: More professional last time having been gelded; that was a decent forward step; considered

runners.name: Sable Island
runners.spotlight: Has gone backwards from her debut third on Tapeta in the spring for a yard not noted for 2yos these days; first-time headgear will need to make a difference.
runners.comment: Yard not noted for 2yos these days; first-time headgear will need to make a difference

runners.name: Dubai Charm
runners.spotlight: Has gone backwards, latterly pulling hard when out of her depth at Royal Ascot; first two races, including her third here, might have worked out better and she has a bit to prove down to 5f for a yard that has a much better record with 2yos on the AW than turf.
runners.comment: Has gone backwards; pulled hard when out of her depth at Royal Ascot; bit to prove

runners.name: Cydney Sweenie
runners.spotlight: Did well to get as close on the AW second time, having got upset and pulled hard, but ran poorly last time; maybe that was down to the firm ground or the first-time hood (off here) but it leaves her something to prove for a yard that's 0-21 with 2yos this year.
runners.comment: Ran poorly last time; maybe that was down to the firm ground or the hood, but bit to prove

runners.name: Miss U Gino
runners.spotlight: Big prices for three runs (5f-6f) and finished well held; it is hard to make a case for her.
runners.comment: Big prices for three runs (5f-6f) and finished well held; it's hard to make a case for her

races.race_name: ATI Tank Hire Memorial Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Dream Vega
runners.spotlight: Beaten a neck by Raneem at Doncaster (7f, good) on second start and is 7lb better off with that rival here; looks sure to go go well.
runners.comment: Beaten a neck by Raneem at Doncaster on second start and is 7lb better off.
runners.owner: Hot To Trot Racing 2 & J Fill

runners.name: Starlight Lass
runners.spotlight: Caught the eye when runner-up at this track (7f, good to soft) last month; improved when making all to beat her only two rivals at Newmarket (1m, good to firm) and looks a cracking prospect.
runners.comment: Improved when making all to beat two rivals at Newmarket and looks a cracking prospect.

runners.name: Raneem
runners.spotlight: Overcame a slow start to make a winning debut at Doncaster (7f, good; 5-2) last month by a neck from Dream Vega; wears first-time hood and steps up in trip; carries a penalty but looks to have a bright future and should go close.
runners.comment: Overcame a slow start to make a winning debut at Doncaster last month from Dream Vega.

runners.name: Sakura Impact
runners.spotlight: First foal; by Mind Your Biscuits; dam Japanese 6f/7f dirt winner, sister to Japanese 7.5f winner Carnet, half-sister to Japanese 1m1f winner Gran Conexion, out of Italian 1m2f Group 1 winner; makes her debut and has her work cut out against three above-average rivals.
runners.comment: Makes her debut and has her work cut out against three above-average rivals.

races.race_name: Great Yarmouth Racecourse Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Waterford Castle
runners.spotlight: Inclined to pull hard and cracked late on over 1m4f at Royal Ascot, having bumped into a few progressive winners previously; sets the standard back into maiden company but can hang right and has had eight cracks at it now.
runners.comment: Sets the standard back into maiden company but can hang right and is exposed

runners.name: Hollywell Stream
runners.spotlight: Second on debut last autumn; comeback run on Tapeta was too bad to be true and she got back on track upped to this trip (good to firm) last time when beaten a neck at Doncaster; the sex allowance brings her into the equation for an in-form yard, under William Buick (10-43 for them).
runners.comment: Back on track upped to this trip latest when beaten a neck at Doncaster; in the equation

runners.name: Ancestor
runners.spotlight: 200,000gns yearling whose opening Salisbury fourth (1m2f, good) in May came behind three talented rivals; he ran well below market expectations, though, in finishing a long way off the front three and will need to settle better if he's to progress.
runners.comment: Well below market expectations on debut and will need to settle better if he's to progress

runners.name: Seacole
runners.spotlight: 400,000gns yearling who made a fair debut at Nottingham recently (1m2f, good) when chasing home a long odds-on favourite; entitled to have learned from that.
runners.comment: Fair debut (1m2f, good) when chasing home a long odds-on favourite; entitled to improve

runners.name: Kokbastau
runners.spotlight: In at the deep end when sixth on his debut last September, in a 1m Newbury conditions event, and it spoke in his favour that he started among the favourites; it will be interesting to see how this 300,00gns foal goes in the market this time after ten months off.
runners.comment: In at the deep end on his debut last September; market useful after ten months off

runners.name: Traveling Man
runners.spotlight: Well-related 360,000gns yearling who was beaten a long way on his soft-ground debut a month ago; bettered that at Redcar next time but handicaps may be his time to shine after today.
runners.comment: Better at Redcar last time but handicaps may be his time to shine after today
runners.owner: P Hickman And Lord Lloyd Webber

races.race_name: Marine Lodge Handicap

runners.name: Prefer The Sister
runners.spotlight: Highly competitive with James Owen for last four starts, notably when running away with a Brighton handicap (7f, good to firm) eight days ago; creditable second there yesterday with a hood added; had 1m form last season; highly respected if she's brought out quickly again.
runners.comment: Bolted up at Brighton eight days ago (7f); second there yesterday; had 1m form in 2025

runners.name: Heer's Sadie
runners.spotlight: Three times a course winner, including over 1m last July; ran into an improver here four weeks ago and she looks set to give another good account.
runners.comment: Conditions suit and she bumped into an improver last time; one to take seriously

runners.name: Bizarre Law
runners.spotlight: Came from an unpromising position to win a 7f handicap at Doncaster (good to soft) in May; has not matched it in two runs since and this isn't sure to set up for him.
runners.comment: Came from the back to win a big-field 7f handicap at Doncaster in May; less good since

runners.name: Charlatan
runners.spotlight: Five-time AW winner but still looking for a first turf win; well beaten in a C&D handicap six weeks ago; on a winning mark but not exactly solid.
runners.comment: 0-5 on turf and well beaten here in May; on a handy mark but not a solid option

runners.name: Regal Guest
runners.spotlight: 0-7 and he has beaten just three rivals home in his four handicap starts; tumbling down the weights but carries risk.
runners.comment: Poor form in his four handicap runs; tumbling down the weights but plenty to prove

runners.name: Rokuni
runners.spotlight: Poor strike-rate and his three runs for his new trainer haven't suggested he was primed to double his tally.
runners.comment: Poor strike-rate and yet to shine for his new stable; too much to prove

races.race_name: Haven Handicap

runners.name: Divot
runners.spotlight: Longstanding maiden who's proved very expensive to follow in AW handicaps over the past year or so; didn't improve on earlier turf efforts at Leicester last month but this race is weaker again.
runners.comment: Didn't improve on earlier turf efforts at Leicester last month but this is weaker again

runners.name: Zafaan
runners.spotlight: Won a 0-50 classified event over C&D last summer and followed up in the same race 12 days ago; not always consistent and is no certainty to back it up, going without cheekpieces this time, but holds major claims under Billy Loughnane.
runners.comment: Made it two C&D wins 12 days ago; holds major claims under Billy Loughnane

runners.name: Spaceage Love Song
runners.spotlight: Tapeta winner early in the year who's achieved little in a handful of runs on turf; has been as far as 1m6f and drops from 1m4f, returning from a few months off.
runners.comment: Tapeta winner; has been as far as 1m6f and drops from 1m4f, back from a few months off
runners.owner: M L W Bell Racing Ltd

runners.name: Sweetstevie
runners.spotlight: Bumped into a better-than-class winner in a soft-ground 0-50 (first-time visor) over C&D last month; easy to back under different conditions at Brighton next time, when well held over 1m4f having pulled hard; hard to know what to expect in truth.
runners.comment: Well held over 1m4f latest having pulled hard; it's hard to know what to expect

runners.name: Sunset In Paris
runners.spotlight: Six-time AW winner who has more off days than on now; better off with Zafaan than when fifth behind him over C&D 12 days ago, back into a handicap today, but needs more.
runners.comment: Six-time AW winner; better off with Zafaan back into a handicap today, but needs more

runners.name: Pure Theory
runners.spotlight: Longstanding maiden who's regressed; tongue-tie quickly removed and she's not obviously fancied back from a couple of months off.
runners.comment: Tongue-tie quickly removed; not obviously fancied back from a couple of months off

runners.name: Zaraquelle
runners.spotlight: Ex-Ed Dunlop maiden; two fair runs over hurdles and not a bad effort on the AW for her current yard last summer, and the market should tell a tale back from the best part of a year off.
runners.comment: Three fair efforts for this yard last summer; market will help after almost a year off

races.race_name: Pinker's Pond Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Filey Beach
runners.spotlight: Won two in a row over C&D (good) in May, taking record here to 3-4; beaten favourite in AW classified since but he may well be superior on turf; high on the list returned to grass.
runners.comment: Two C&D wins in May and returns to turf after being a beaten favourite on AW

runners.name: Without Delay
runners.spotlight: Slow starts are becoming an issue and she's been well beaten on her last two starts; however, she showed spark when third over C&D (good) three runs ago and she won this last year (good to firm); not discounted.
runners.comment: Well beaten on last two starts but showed spark previously and she won this last year

runners.name: Saisons d'Or
runners.spotlight: 11yo who made virtually all to win at Southwell (7f, AW) in April; unplaced on both starts since but he failed to settle and was denied a clear run here on the first occasion; has won here three times; not ruled out.
runners.comment: 11yo who won on Southwell AW in April and has won here three times; not ruled out

runners.name: Classy Clarets
runners.spotlight: Won at Hamilton (5f, good) in May and he was back on the scoresheet at Musselburgh (7f, good) last Tuesday, making virtually all under Jack Nicholls; yard continues in flying form and he's respected under a penalty.
runners.comment: Won at Musselburgh last Tuesday and yard continues in flying form; respected under penalty

runners.name: Summer Rain
runners.spotlight: When fifth of 14 at Beverley (7.4f, good) last month he was trapped wide and failed to settle, so that run wasn't without promise, but he's since been well beaten at Newcastle (6f, AW) and is now 0-13; cheekpieces go on; plenty to prove.
runners.comment: Penultimate run wasn't without promise but well beaten since & now 0-13; cheekpieces added

runners.name: Jenni
runners.spotlight: Won at Musselburgh (7f, good) last May when 8lb higher but failed to hit the same heights for the remainder of last season and she's been well beaten on both outings this term.
runners.comment: Well handicapped on her win last May but well beaten on both outings this term

runners.name: Indy's Angel
runners.spotlight: Returned to form with 25-1 second of 18 at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) last week; she can't be dismissed today but she's very inconsistent and has won just one of her 21 races, while the return to 7f also poses a question.
runners.comment: 25-1 second of 18 at Thirsk last week, but that was over 6f; she's very inconsistent

runners.name: Groundsman
runners.spotlight: He's 1lb lower than when winning at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) last September and is also effective on turf; however, following a break he's finished down the field on grass on his last two starts; has to get back on track.
runners.comment: He's below his last winning mark but has finished down the field on his last two starts

runners.name: Coconut Bay
runners.spotlight: Won four times last year; this 7yo hasn't been in the same form this season but her recent 3l fourth to Classy Clarets at Musselburgh (7f, good) was a step back in the right direction and she's a three-time winner at Catterick; remains 8lb below her last winning mark and is capable of going well.
runners.comment: Step back in right direction at Musselburgh recently and she's a three-time winner here

races.race_name: Download The Raceday Ready App Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Lairy Mary
runners.spotlight: Improved effort when winning a Beverley claimer (5f, good to firm) in May; finished behind Mardy Bum at Wetherby last month, however, and wouldn't be open to the same progress as that rival.
runners.comment: Won a 5f claimer in May but she finished behind Mardy Bum at Wetherby last month

runners.name: Explainingislosing
runners.spotlight: Some promise could be gleaned from his first two runs but he has been well beaten in 6f sellers on his last two starts (poor draw at Chester on first of them); drawn widest and others look safer.
runners.comment: Well beaten in 6f sellers on his last two starts; wide draw to contend with on h'cap debut

runners.name: Fortunate
runners.spotlight: Standout effort in Chester seller (6f, good) in May, finishing fourth in a useful race for the grade; failed to back it up on a slower surface at Goodwood one week later; cheekpieces added for nursery debut.
runners.comment: Good 6f run at Chester in May; ground a valid excuse latest; headgear on for nursery debut

runners.name: Bellatina
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer; she has finished second in two of her four starts, finishing clear of the third at Hamilton (5f, good to firm) 13 days ago; should give a good account now handicapping at a modest level.
runners.comment: Prominent racer; second in two of her four starts; should go well now handicapping

runners.name: Mr Darling
runners.spotlight: Poor form in three novice/maiden runs; this should be more suitable but he is not easy to recommend.
runners.comment: Poor form in three runs this summer; not easily recommended now handicapping

runners.name: Arcadian Days
runners.spotlight: Not obviously well treated on what she has achieved in her three 5f runs but she was sent off at a single-figure price for her debut and may do better now handicapping at a low level; drawn wider than ideal though.
runners.comment: Not achieved a great deal but was sent off at single-figure price for debut; nursery debut

runners.name: Mardy Bum
runners.spotlight: Finished last on her first two starts but there was much more promise at Wetherby (5.5f, good to firm; hooded first time) where she kept on for fourth having met some trouble; likely improver now handicapping but the Wetherby form isn't working out.
runners.comment: Much improved when keeping on for fourth at Wetherby last month; likely more to come

runners.name: Najmet Minzaal
runners.spotlight: Fourth in 5f novice events at Wolverhampton (AW) and Lingfield (good to firm) this summer; bred to do better and she moves into handicaps with potential; stable's record at Catterick (five wins, a second and a third from ten runners) heightens interest.
runners.comment: Fourth in two novice runs; smart pedigree; yard's record at the track heightens interest

runners.name: Penny Capri
runners.spotlight: Modest form in three runs this summer, finishing behind Najmet Minzaal at Lingfield (5f, good to firm) 11 days ago; may do better now handicapping but she needs to.
runners.comment: Modest form in maiden/novice company, finishing behind Najmet Minzaal latest; needs more

races.race_name: Racing TV Profits Returned To Racing Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Big Hitter
runners.spotlight: Shaped well on soft ground on her Chepstow debut (6f) and ran to a similar level when missing out by a nose at Newbury (6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; should be quick enough for this fast 5f and she holds solid claims.
runners.comment: Two good efforts last month under varying conditions; looks the one to beat

runners.name: Time Glory
runners.spotlight: In need of the experience on her debut at Redcar (6f, good to firm) in May; more clued up when a front-running third of nine at York (5f, good) 26 days ago; one of the likelier winners.
runners.comment: Stepped forward from Redcar debut when 3rd at York last month; one of the likelier winners

runners.name: Warby
runners.spotlight: No match for the odds-on favourite when second over C&D (good to firm) on last month's debut but it was still a promising start to her career; open to improvement; market support would be encouraging.
runners.comment: No match for odds-on favourite but still ran well for 2nd over C&D last month; do better

runners.name: Angel In My Heart
runners.spotlight: £38,000 breeze-up 2yo; second foal of a maiden half-sister to Group-race winners Bocca Baciata, Topeka and Kalsa; neither of the stable's two juvenile winners this year won on debut but both ran well.
runners.comment: £38,000 breeze-up 2yo; dam a well-related maiden; fair standard to aim at on debut

runners.name: Ma Fille De Reve
runners.spotlight: Low-level form in two runs last month, the latest over C&D; minor nurseries more suitable after this.
runners.comment: Low-level form in two runs last month, the latest over C&D; minor nurseries beckon

runners.name: Inglewood
runners.spotlight: Prominent for a long way when finishing fifth of 12 at Thirsk (5f, good) in May; open to improvement but it will be needed.
runners.comment: Prominent for a long way when fifth on debut in May (5f, good); open to improvement

races.race_name: All Races Live On Racing TV Handicap

runners.name: Beyond The Bar
runners.spotlight: Won a Redcar novice last October (1m, good); rather disappointing in handicaps this season, but on a career-low mark as a result.
runners.comment: Won Redcar novice in October (1m); disappointing in handicaps this term; on a good mark

runners.name: Masaban
runners.spotlight: Easy winner off a 9lb lower mark on handicap debut at Ripon in May (1m, good); creditable third at Doncaster next time (1m, good to soft) but connections blamed the faster ground when well below his best last time at Pontefract (1m, good); today's sharp 7f on fast ground unlikely to suit.
runners.comment: Easy Ripon win on handicap debut (1m); today's sharp 7f on fast ground unlikely to suit

runners.name: Vega Storm
runners.spotlight: Unexposed maiden; some promise in maiden/novice company (including over C&D); rather disappointing when well beaten on handicap debut at Doncaster last time (7f, good to firm); bit to prove.
runners.comment: Some promise in maiden/novice company; well beaten on handicap debut last time

runners.name: Dacres Cross
runners.spotlight: Won a Carlisle nursery last August (6f, good); best run since when fourth of 20 at York last time (7f, good; third and fifth have won since) when Harswell Angel was eighth; chance.
runners.comment: 6f nursery winner last August; good fourth of 20 at York last time; chance on that run

runners.name: Magistery
runners.spotlight: Won a Carlisle nursery on soft last October (6f); well below her best all three runs since; return to faster ground a concern.
runners.comment: 6f nursery winner in 2025 (soft); below her best three runs since; plenty to prove

runners.name: Harswell Angel
runners.spotlight: Didn't get the best of runs when eighth of 20 at York two runs ago (7f, good; Dacres Cross fourth); fair fifth at Doncaster last time (7f, good); each-way chance.
runners.comment: Behind Dacres Cross at York two runs ago (troubled run); fair run latest; each-way chance

runners.name: Starryfield
runners.spotlight: Placed in four of his five starts and was a creditable 2.5l seventh in a Newmarket handicap on the other occasion; disappointing third when favourite for a Windsor maiden last time (6f, good to firm; beaten more than 8l); chance back at 7f in handicap company
runners.comment: Placed in four of his five starts, and a close seventh in a handicap in the other; chance

runners.name: Indefensible
runners.spotlight: Maiden who has a chance on his form when second at Beverley on his handicap debut (7.5f, good to soft) and when runner-up in a Thirsk maiden (7f, good) two runs ago.
runners.comment: Maiden; has a chance on his second at Beverley on his handicap debut in April

runners.name: Bye Law
runners.spotlight: Won an Ayr maiden and a Redcar novice (both over 6f on good) last August; some fair runs in handicaps this time, but step up to 7f not sure to suit (well beaten previous start at the trip).
runners.comment: 6f maiden/novice winner in 2025; fair runs in handicaps this time; better at 6f than 7f

runners.name: Master Of Entropy
runners.spotlight: Maiden; promise in maiden/novice company and fair fourth of five at Nottingham on second handicap start last time (6f, good to firm); should improve back at 7f; wouldn't rule out.
runners.comment: Maiden; fair fourth of five last time (6f); 7f should suit better; wouldn't rule out

races.race_name: Bet At racingtv.com Handicap (For The Turmeric Challenge Trophy)

runners.name: Not So Sobers
runners.spotlight: Won over hurdles at Hereford in May and followed up on the Flat over this C&D (good to firm); it's disconcerting he was pulled up on his chase debut at Stratford three weeks ago but he may well bounce back and play a leading role reverting to this code.
runners.comment: Two wins in May (hurdles then C&D Flat); pulled up over fences since but could bounce back

runners.name: Himself
runners.spotlight: Completed 1m6f AW hat-trick early this year but he's been a long way below that level on turf on his last three starts and is 0-15 on grass.
runners.comment: 1m6f AW hat-trick early this year but long way below that level on turf on last three runs

runners.name: Lady Buttercup
runners.spotlight: Very modest form over hurdles and well beaten at 25-1 on her Flat handicap debut here (1m4f, good) two months ago; she's hard to fancy on the back of that but the first-time tongue-tie may help this bumper winner and she's not written off.
runners.comment: Well beaten on Flat handicap debut but tongue-tie could help this bumper winner

runners.name: Sugarpiehoneybunch
runners.spotlight: Course winner who scored at Hamilton last June; however, she's failed to get competitive on her five starts since last September (two of them this year) and needs to find something extra.
runners.comment: Course winner who scored at Hamilton last June but she's failed to shine this year

runners.name: Speechman
runners.spotlight: His losing sequence continues but he's dropped down the weights and his third of five at Beverley (1m4f, good to firm) last Friday in a first-time visor (retained) was slightly more encouraging; could build on that.
runners.comment: Losing sequence continues but his third of five at Beverley was slightly more encouraging

runners.name: Bunker Bay
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on the Flat last September and he's been in top form over hurdles of late at Market Rasen, winning two in a row (2m/2m4f, good) before finishing second on his last start; respected back in this code.
runners.comment: In top form over hurdles of late at Market Rasen and respected back in this code

races.race_name: Racing Again 15th July Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Velvet Rhythm
runners.spotlight: Improved for handicapping this year, always prominent when winning at Newmarket and over C&D in May and then overcoming a slow start back here 16 days ago; another 4lb rise to contend with but she should make a bold bid to maintain her unbeaten course record.
runners.comment: Three handicap wins this year, including 2-2 over C&D; another bold bid expected
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum

runners.name: Lady Gormire
runners.spotlight: Two encouraging runs over 6f here for her new stable; steps back up to 7f for her handicap debut; not fully exposed just yet.
runners.comment: Placed in two 6f races here for new yard; back up to 7f for handicap debut; unexposed

runners.name: Only Dream Big
runners.spotlight: Made all for an easy win at Redcar (7f, good) three weeks ago; had to work harder to follow up at Musselburgh (1m, good) three days later; drop back to 7f can help but she is another 6lb higher in her hat-trick bid and this is a rise in class.
runners.comment: Chasing a hat-trick after Class 6 wins at Redcar and Musselburgh; improving but needs more

runners.name: Rogue Citation
runners.spotlight: She made a promising debut at Carlisle (6f, good to firm) last summer and then scrambled home in a 6f novice at Southwell in October; disappointed at Southwell on her seasonal/handicap debut 12 weeks ago (trainer's representative reported that she failed to stay 7f on her first run after a six-month break); possible there will be stronger stayers in today's field but she's unexposed and wears a first-time tongue-tie.
runners.comment: 6f AW win last October; didn't see out 7f on her reappearance; still has low mileage

runners.name: Donna Nook
runners.spotlight: Ended a losing run when winning a 1m handicap at Ripon last month; fair fourth at Carlisle (7f, good to firm) two weeks ago; should give her running but one or more of the 3yos may have her measure.
runners.comment: Arrives in good form but has few secrets and one or more of the 3yos may have her measure

runners.name: Ziggy's Queen
runners.spotlight: In good form on AW over the winter, winning at Wolverhampton (6f) and Lingfield (7f); 1lb lower than for the latter win but she hasn't maintained her form back on turf this summer, including behind Velvet Rhythm over C&D 16 days ago.
runners.comment: Not matched this winter's AW best back on turf this summer; behind Velvet Rhythm latest

races.race_name: Dino Family Day @ fairyhouse Optional Claiming Race

runners.name: Tenacious
runners.spotlight: Has had plenty of chances, pick being Gowran handicap third (1m), lost action at Ballinrobe latest; weighted to go well.
runners.comment: Gowran handicap third had excuses last time; weighted to go well

runners.name: Zitkala Sa
runners.spotlight: Shaped creditably on handicap debut last month over just shy of this trip at Gowran, staying on third after a slow start; big chance with a repeat of that run.
runners.comment: Gowran handicap third; big player

runners.name: Borora Aura
runners.spotlight: Ballinrobe claiming third probably her best effort; safely held in handicaps since; seemingly tough task at the weights.
runners.comment: Ballinrobe claiming third held in handicaps since; seemingly tough task at the weights

runners.name: Pass The Buck
runners.spotlight: Ballinrobe maiden at just shy of this trip was okay but stamina test (2m1f) may have been too much at Limerick latest; back in trip with visor now replacing cheekpieces, can go well.
runners.comment: Penultimate Ballinrobe run gives him claims; visor could help too

runners.name: Mare Crisium
runners.spotlight: Three maiden runs all on soft/heavy, taking a backward step at Limerick last time; tongue-tie fitted and contrasting ground conditions.
runners.comment: Three maidens on soft/heavy, backward at Limerick; tongue-tie fitted and quicker ground

runners.name: Akissfromarose
runners.spotlight: Beaten a long way in four maidens over shorter trips; blinkers tried latest now replaced by tongue-tie and cheekpieces and steps up in trip.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way in four maidens over shorter; new headgear combination

runners.name: Henry Hudson
runners.spotlight: Hasn't counted in three maidens, showing mild promise; upped in trip now.
runners.comment: Hasn't counted in three maidens, showing mild promise; upped in trip now

runners.name: Music And Song
runners.spotlight: Fourth in similar Ballinrobe contest recently; basement 40 mark leaves her with lots to find.
runners.comment: Fourth in similar Ballinrobe contest; basement 40 mark leaves her with lots to find

runners.name: Arizona Star
runners.spotlight: Beaten a long way in all five starts, last twice in handicaps; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way in all five starts, last twice in handicaps; hard to fancy

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Argentarius
runners.spotlight: Won a barrier trial and ran a cracker in a maiden at Cork (6f, good) when beaten 0.5l into second by subsequent Group 3 winner Ballinea Star; the one to beat if building on that excellent effort.
runners.comment: Barrier trial winner, went close behind subsequent Gr' 3 winner at Cork, the one to beat

runners.name: Livenka
runners.spotlight: Promise in both starts; beaten 2.5l into third of six on debut by subsequent Queen Mary winner Victorious at Naas (6f, good) in April; not as good next time upped to 7f at the Curragh when beaten 8.25l; drop back in trip here a plus and has a chance on that debut effort.
runners.comment: Not far behind Queen Mary winner on debut, 7f too far latest, chance back down in trip

runners.name: Crayons In The Sky
runners.spotlight: Sent off at 12-1 on debut over C&D in median sires series race a week ago and caught the eye finishing a 3l second after meeting trouble in running; enters calculations now with improvement likely to be forthcoming.
runners.comment: 12-1 and ran a fine race over C&D on debut last week, enters calculations now

runners.name: Film Set
runners.spotlight: Siyouni filly; dam 1m winner (inc 2yo/Group 3; RPR 104), half-sister to winners Propose (1m2f) and Minerva (7f 2yo), out of US 6.5f/1m Grade 2 winning sister to 1m Group 1 winner Mohaather; Lordan prefers stablemate but still worth a market check.
runners.comment: Siyouni filly, dam a 2yo 1m winner, impeccably bred but Lordan prefers stablemate
runners.owner: Westerberg & Mrs Magnier & M Tabor & D Smith

runners.name: Silver Kiss
runners.spotlight: Saxon Warrior filly; dam Listed-placed 7f winner (RPR 99), half-sister to winners Bella Isabella (Group-placed 7f) and Sara Valentina (6.6f), out of 1m1f Group 3 winning half-sister to useful 7f winners Joailliere and True Solitaire; market best guide on debut.
runners.comment: Saxon Warrior filly, dam listed placed 7f winner, market best guide on debut

runners.name: Annie Tips
runners.spotlight: Soldier's Call filly; dam unraced half-sister to Italian 5f winner Isolina, out of maiden sister to 6f 2yo/2m hurdle winner Freedom Square, is granddaughter of sister to 1m Listed winner Speirbhean (dam of Dewhurst winner Teofilo); likely best watched on debut.
runners.comment: Soldier's Call filly, dam unraced, likely best watched on debut

runners.name: Golden Ring
runners.spotlight: Wootton Bassett filly; half-sister to four winners inc Armory (7f-1m2f inc 2yo Group 2; RPR 119), Subsequent (11.6f-14.5f inc Listed; 111) and HMS Seahorse (1m4f Flat, 100; useful 2m/2m4f hurdle); dam Group-placed 6f 2yo winner (108); looks top yard's first string on rider arrangements.
runners.comment: Wootton Bassett filly, dam 6f 2yo winner, looks yard's first string on rider arrangements
runners.owner: Westerberg & Mrs Magnier & M Tabor & D Smith

runners.name: Star Of State
runners.spotlight: State Of Rest filly; E85,000 yearling; half-sister to winners Yaahobby (5f-7f AW; RPR 70) and Aussie Nation (Australian 1m2f/10.5f); dam 6f/7f 2yo winner (inc Group 3; 104), closely related to useful 6f-1m winner Band Width; in good hands; check the market.
runners.comment: E85,000 State Of Rest filly, dam 6f/7f 2yo winner, in good hands, check the market

runners.name: Dropping Dimes
runners.spotlight: Huge odds and no impression in 6f maidens at the Curragh and Cork; others preferred.
runners.comment: Huge odds and no impression in two 6f maidens, others preferred

runners.name: Sapphire Petal
runners.spotlight: 33-1 and well held on debut at Cork in the race in which Argentarius finished second; much more needed.
runners.comment: Well held 33-1 shot on debut at Cork, much more needed

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF (C & G) Maiden

runners.name: La Tache
runners.spotlight: Mehmas colt sent off at 12-1 on debut at the Curragh (6f, gd-yld) and wasn't knocked about when keeping on well from the back in the closing stages for an 8.5l sixth of 13 after a sluggish start; likely to know more now and could go well in first-time blinkers.
runners.comment: Promising run on debut at the Curragh, should know more now, blinkers on, go well

runners.name: Banks Of The Boyne
runners.spotlight: No signs yet of winning potential in maidens over C&D (good) and at Roscommon (7.5f, good); may need more time and experience.
runners.comment: No sign of winning potential in maidens over C&D and at Roscommon, needs more time

runners.name: Nail House
runners.spotlight: No Nay Never colt; 80,000gns yearling; half-brother to 5f 2yo winner Dinamo (RPR 52); dam 1m AW winner (70), half-sister to winners Go Angellica (1m 2yo Listed) and Southern Belle (useful 5f/6f inc 2yo); one of two for yard and market can guide on debut.
runners.comment: No Nay Never colt, dam 1m AW winner, one of two for yard, market best guide on debut

runners.name: Supreme Lord
runners.spotlight: Starman colt; 400,000gns yearling; half-brother to Listed-placed 6f 2yo winner Letherfly (RPR 93); dam 5f AW winner (83), half-sister to 5f 2yo Listed winner Orlaith, out of unraced half-sister to 7f 2yo Group 1 winner Toormore; likely type on paper from respected source, with some big-race entries; can be a player.
runners.comment: 400,000gns Starman colt, dam 5f winner, likely type on paper, can be a player

runners.name: King's Fury
runners.spotlight: Kingman colt; 160,000 yearling; closely related to French 1m4f winner Senguun; dam unraced half-sister to French 1m2f winner Frankish, out of 1,000 Guineas winner Miss France; showed ability when second in Naas barrier trial; interesting.
runners.comment: 160,000gns Kingman colt, runner up in Naas barrier trial, interesting debutant
runners.owner: Philip Antonacci & AC Crawford Farms LLC

runners.name: City Of Gold
runners.spotlight: Wootton Bassett colt; E400,000 yearling; dam French 1m/1m1f winner (inc Listed; RPR 106), out of maiden sister to 1m3f Listed winner Parthenon, half-sister to Group 3 winners Magna Graecia (15.5f) and Graikos (1m1f); preferred by Lordan and should go well on debut for top yard.
runners.comment: E400,000 Wootton Bassett colt, dam listed winner, preferred by Lordan, should go well

runners.name: Mutamarid Lsk
runners.spotlight: Ten Sovereigns colt; dam 1m AW 2yo/Qatari 1m2f winner (RPR 86), closely related to Scandinavian 1m 2yo-1m7f winner Zakopane, half-sister to winners Admiral De Vega (Swedish 1m1f Group 3) and Zeeyara (French 1m2f Listed) behind King's Fury when seventh in Naas barrier trial; probably best watched.
runners.comment: Ten Sovereigns colt, behind King's Fury in Naas barrier trial, probably best watched

runners.name: Captain James Cook
runners.spotlight: Blackbeard colt one of two for top yard; the choice of Moore when 100-30 on debut at the Curragh last month but beat just one rival home; will need to improve plenty on that and looks the stable's second string on rider arrangements here.
runners.comment: Blackbeard colt beat just one rival home on debut, Lordan prefers stablemate

races.race_name: Fairyhouse Winter Festival 28th & 29th November Rated Race

runners.name: Chutzpal
runners.spotlight: Capable under both codes, both Flat wins coming in 1m6f Killarney handicaps, last summer off 72 before good second at Newmarket (2m2f); Curragh comeback run in late May was poor but more expected of here.
runners.comment: Curragh comeback run in late May was poor but more expected of here

runners.name: Sir Callisto
runners.spotlight: In fine form over 1m4f on the AW since return from a break, winning off 72 in early April and close second off revised mark later that month; didn't count on turf return at Gowran last month and hood now added to usual tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Progressive AW form not transferred to turf last month but don't rule out with hood added

runners.name: Royal Hollow
runners.spotlight: Talented dual-purpose performer is only 1-8 on the Flat but brought her mark to a career-high at Ballinrobe last month when just denied close home in fillies' handicap over 1m5f; quick ground a slight concern, big player if handling it.
runners.comment: Career-best Flat effort when pipped at Ballinrobe recently; quicker ground a concern

runners.name: Light Up The Dark
runners.spotlight: Two bumper wins and was gaining a second win on the Flat when readily taking 1m6f Gowran handicap in April (soft); 8lb higher and quicker ground to contend with (has won on good).
runners.comment: Ready Gowran handicap winner up 8lb and quicker ground to contend with

runners.name: Not Just Any Eagle
runners.spotlight: Four Flat wins at up to 1m4f, including Leopardstown handicap last season off 78; yet to hit form this campaign though, twice not appearing to stay today's trip; bit to prove now.
runners.comment: Yet to hit form this campaign though, twice not appearing to stay today's trip

runners.name: Pavilion End
runners.spotlight: Sole win came on AW (1m4f maiden); well beaten both turf outings this term and looks to have a fair bit to find.
runners.comment: AW winner well beaten both turf outings this term and looks to have a fair bit to find

runners.name: Tounsivator
runners.spotlight: Talented hurdler whose three Flat wins include 1m4f Tramore handicap last summer; not seen since midfield in 2m Naas premier handicap in October; another likely Galway-bound, jockey booking encouraging.
runners.comment: Absent since October; likely Galway-bound, jockey booking encouraging

runners.name: Buddy One
runners.spotlight: Smart staying hurdler/chaser, midfield in BetMGM Handicap at Cheltenham in March when last seen; lightly raced on Flat, winning 1m5f Ballinrobe maiden last season, well held in Leopardstown handicap subsequently; may just need this comeback run with Galway on the horizon.
runners.comment: Smart jumper; Ballinrobe Flat maiden winner may just need this run
runners.owner: E Lynch & T C Quinn & John J McGrath

races.race_name: Darley Irish EBF Stanerra Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)

runners.name: Goodie Two Shoes
runners.spotlight: Last year's winner who went on to post a career-best when second of 24 in Group 1 Melbourne Cup (2m, good-to-soft); last month's Limerick comeback run well below her best but entitled to come on for that and major chance on ratings.
runners.comment: Last year's winner and Melbourne Cup better for recent comeback run; big player

runners.name: Floresta
runners.spotlight: Progressive last season, two wins included Listed contest at Leopardstown (1m6f, good) and signed off with very creditable fifth in the Group 2 Park Hill at Doncaster; has to bounce back from a poor comeback run in Gowran Listed in early May and cheekpieces tried.
runners.comment: Listed winner last term but has to bounce back from a poor comeback run; cheekpieces tried

runners.name: Bloom
runners.spotlight: Cork 2yo maiden winner highly-tried in three runs this term when tried in pacemaking role, notably third behind Thundering On in 1m2f Navan Group 3; blinkers had no effect when down the field in Munster Oaks latest and now replaced by cheekpieces and upped in trip.
runners.comment: Navan Listed third hasn't been built on; upped in trip and change of headgear
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: Perfect Your Craft
runners.spotlight: Winner of three of her six races for Ralph Beckett; purchased for 300,000gns and cracking effort on seasonal return/stable debut when just denied in 1m2f Curragh premier handicap in May; didn't land a blow but not beaten far in Group 3 Munster Oaks latest (first-time cheekpieces) so not one to dismiss lightly.
runners.comment: Munster Oaks fifth needs to find more now upped in trip

runners.name: Ice Dancer
runners.spotlight: Group-placed 2yo winner last year who has finished last in all three runs this term, most recently Group 3 Munster Oaks (two of today's rivals ahead).
runners.comment: Last in all three runs this term, most recently Group 3 Munster Oaks
runners.owner: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Galileo Dame
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose mare, whose only Flat win came in Leopardstown 3yo maiden (1m2f); in good form however this term in very competitive handicaps, second at Navan, close fourth of 15 in 2m2f Chester Cup and 4.5l off stablemate Kizlyar when seventh of 20 in 2m4f Ascot Stakes last month; bit to find with some of these now entering Group company but don't rule out.
runners.comment: Smart handicap form; bit to find entering Group company but don't rule out
runners.owner: Annus Mirabilis Synd'/Sean O'Driscoll/Middle Cow Unlimited

runners.name: Nuit
runners.spotlight: Maiden has been highly tried at times to no avail but did pick up some black type when third behind Floresta in Leopardstown Listed last term; not a bad effort when fourth in Gowran Listed in May but this is a stronger race.
runners.comment: Listed third to Floresta last year her best run; okay Gowran run latest but more needed

runners.name: Jannah Star
runners.spotlight: Maiden twice runner-up in good-ground maidens last year and career-best when beaten 5.5l in 1m6f Gowran Listed in May; never sighted in Group 3 Munster Oaks at Cork on latest; again has plenty on her plate here.
runners.comment: Maiden never sighted in Group 3 Munster Oaks on latest; again has plenty on her plate

runners.name: Dreamkeeper
runners.spotlight: Ran away with 1m4f Fairyhouse maiden (good) last month but limitations seemingly exposed 18 days later in Roscommon Listed over same trip; upped in distance here.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 3yo needs to improve plenty for this step up in trip to play a major role
runners.owner: Mrs H Shanahan & Mrs Jane Shanahan

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden

runners.name: Bamako Beach
runners.spotlight: Narrowly denied on first two starts in 7f maidens at Naas (yld-sft) and Gowran (yld); not disgraced when pitched into Group 1 company at the Curragh last time (1m, good); rated 102 and the one to beat back in these calmer waters.
runners.comment: Narrowly denied in first two maidens, not disgraced in Gr' 1 latest, the one to beat

runners.name: Sindagan
runners.spotlight: In the first three in three of his four starts (all on easy ground) and rated 83; attracted the attention of the stewards when eased up late for third at Gowran (7f, soft) last time in first-time cheekpieces (discarded); should be in the mix again if handling these quicker conditions (dam related to good ground winners).
runners.comment: In the frame in all four starts, quicker ground an unknown, place chance if acts on it
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Goomah
runners.spotlight: Rated 74; standout effort in three previous maiden runs a 0.75l third of 9 at Leopardstown (7f, good); disappointing run off 77 on handicap debut at the Curragh (1m, good), weakening into last of 12; dropping back to 7f is a plus but drawn wide and probably place claims at best.
runners.comment: Struggled on h'cap debut latest, drop back in trip a plus, drawn wide, place shout

runners.name: Little Sure Shot
runners.spotlight: Rated 72; fine effort on debut in June of last year at Leopardstown (7.5f, good) but nowhere near that level in three subsequent runs; off since a moderate run on testing ground over 6f at the Curragh in March; quicker ground and step back up in trip here a plus but more needed.
runners.comment: Has so far failed to build on last year's promising debut effort, rated 72, needs more

runners.name: Cladach
runners.spotlight: Dark Angel gelding; E220,000 yearling; brother to 7f winner Dark Tornado (RPR 99), half-brother to three winners inc Raintree (7f; 77) and Marie Paradis (1m2f/1m4f; 59); dam 9.4f AW winner (69); bred to be decent but beat just one home in Naas barrier trial.
runners.comment: Dark Angel gelding, dam AW winner, beat just one home in Naas barrier trial

runners.name: Storzando
runners.spotlight: River Boyne gelding; second foal; brother to 5f winner Boyne Lady (RPR 74); dam twice-raced (60) half-sister to winners Centennial (1m4f Group 2) and Siren's Song (1m2f Listed), out of half-sister to 1m1f/1m2f Group 1 winner Croco Rouge; worth a market check on debut.
runners.comment: River Boyne gelding, dam half-sister to Group 2 winner, check the market

runners.name: Chloe's Boy
runners.spotlight: 150-1 and beaten 22l on debut at Naas (1m, good); seems safe to rule out on the back of that tame effort.
runners.comment: 150-1 and beaten 22l on debut at Naas, seems safe to rule out for now

runners.name: Coolshine
runners.spotlight: Triple figure odds for both starts and ran accordingly; look elsewhere.
runners.comment: Triple figure odds for both starts and ran like it, look elsewhere

runners.name: Thumama Sands
runners.spotlight: Down the field at big odds in maidens over C&D and at Limerick on good and soft ground; may need more time.
runners.comment: Heavy defeats at big odds in 7f maidens here and at Gowran, may need more time

runners.name: Farewell To Arms
runners.spotlight: Very modest efforts at big odds in 1m maidens at Gowran and Leopardstown; unlikely winner.
runners.comment: Modest efforts at big odds in maidens at Gowran and Leopardstown, unlikely

runners.name: Passage Of Power
runners.spotlight: Well-bred Into Mischief colt ran a pleasing race over 6f on debut at Dundalk in January when sent off at 16-5; absence since a bit of a concern and drawn wide but pedigree suggests this trip should suit and worth monitoring in the market.
runners.comment: Good effort on debut at Dundalk in January, off since, 7f should suit, check the market

runners.name: Shay's Dream
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in maidens at Dundalk last November and on turf at Limerick in June; will qualify for handicaps after this.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in maidens at Dundalk and Limerick, gets a handicap mark after this

runners.name: Banshof
runners.spotlight: Neither run devoid of promise, over 5f at Dundalk and when keeping on over 6f at the Curragh last time; should appreciate the step up to 7f; might outrun likely odds.
runners.comment: Neither run devoid of promise, step up to 7f should suit, might outrun likely odds

runners.name: Auguste Gusteau
runners.spotlight: Modest efforts all three starts over 5f-6f on yielding ground and on the AW; will probably find his level when tackling handicaps.
runners.comment: Modest efforts all three starts at 5f-6f, probably one for handicaps
runners.owner: One Eight Seven Four Syndicate/Paul J Cahill

runners.name: Pettus Bridge
runners.spotlight: 80-1 and soundly beaten over 1m4f here on debut; can only watched down markedly in distance.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten over 1m4f here on debut when 80-1, big drop in trip now, watch

races.race_name: Winter Festival Early Bird Tickets From 20 Euros Handicap

runners.name: Bishopton
runners.spotlight: 2-7 on the AW but is 1-13 on turf (win came on yielding); won at Dundalk in March off 3lb higher; the best of three turf runs since then came over 7f at Cork on penultimate; not as good dropped back to 6f at the Curragh on latest; moves back up in trip now and might prefer an ease in the ground.
runners.comment: 1-13 on turf, decent Cork run on penultimate, not as good latest, may need easier ground
runners.owner: W Jones/D W Sloan/M C Mocchetti/Kabin Racing Syndicate

runners.name: Indigo Dream
runners.spotlight: AW maiden winner has yet to get her head in front on turf (0-10) but has run some fine races in defeat; not a bad effort when she had two of these behind at the Curragh latest (7f, good); eased 2lb and can go close if the new tongue tie ekes out a bit more.
runners.comment: AW maiden winner, had a couple of these behind latest, eased 2lb, tongue tie on

runners.name: Glory To Be
runners.spotlight: Generally consistent filly; won for a second time at Leopardstown in April (7f, yld-sft); almost added to her tally over 6f (good) here on latest when denied by a head; the step back up to 7f is fine and ground versatile so she has to enter calculations off just 2lb higher.
runners.comment: Raised 2lb for near miss over 6f here latest, step up to 7f fine, enters calculations

runners.name: Rahmi
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner, including two premier handicaps; below best on first two runs in Listed company this term and failed to beat a rival back in handicap company latest; is now 1lb below his last win but a revival is needed for last year's winning stable.
runners.comment: Four-time winner, poor so far this season, now 1lb below last win but needs to revive
runners.owner: Richard McNally & Leo Walsh & L Murrin

runners.name: I Bid You Ajou
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner has been running well this season but yet to get his head in front; all his victories have come over 6f at this venue; 3lb wrong here but he ran well in this race last season to finish a 2.5l second off 1lb higher; thereabouts.
runners.comment: Three course wins at 6f, second in this last season off 1lb higher, thereabouts

runners.name: Exquisite Acclaim
runners.spotlight: Eight-time winner on the AW but just 1-31 on turf; beaten 3l when third of 6 in this last season and just 1lb lower now; finished a couple of places ahead of Tolebi when a 4.5l seventh of 17 at the Curragh on latest; place shout.
runners.comment: 1-31 on turf, 3rd in this last year, ahead of Tolebi on latest at the Curragh, place shout
runners.owner: Thomas J O'Connor & Ms Hazel McGuinness

runners.name: Tolebi
runners.spotlight: A winner in France for Andre Fabre; not bad efforts the last twice, including over C&D on penultimate; eased 1lb for a 5.75l ninth of 17 at the Curragh 12 days ago when racing a touch keenly after a slowish start; not discounted.
runners.comment: Not bad efforts the last twice including over C&D, eased 1lb for latest, not discounted

races.race_name: Racing Again September 21st Handicap

runners.name: Green Kite
runners.spotlight: Second to a clear winner in Killarney maiden last October and similar level of form on latest when chasing home a progressive sort (winner again since) over this trip in Leopardstown handicap last month; both those efforts on much softer ground, untried on ground this quick but big player if handling it, although draw a negative.
runners.comment: Recent Leopardstown second reads well; big player if handling this quicker ground

runners.name: Sonoma Sunset
runners.spotlight: Nothing yet in handicaps, most recently last of 10 on AW in April when cheekpieces (now left off) tried; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Nothing yet in handicaps, cheekpieces worn latest now left off; hard to fancy.

runners.name: Chester Nimitz
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark for former yard in a 6f Navan maiden last October; underwhelming so far this term for current yard although handicapper giving him a chance.
runners.comment: Underwhelming so far this term for current yard although handicapper giving him a chance

runners.name: Shoot To Kill
runners.spotlight: Prolific winner at around this trip, latest in Gowran claimer nearly a year ago; 0-9 for current yard but Down Royal second to Faoladh puts him in the mix on ground he'll handle.
runners.comment: 0-9 for current yard but Down Royal second to Faoladh puts him in the mix

runners.name: Carrigans Grove
runners.spotlight: Enjoyed a successful 2025, winning three sprint handicaps; yet to hit form this term, last of 18 over C&D a week ago in first-time blinkers (now replaced by cheekpieces).
runners.comment: Yet to hit form this term, last of 18 over C&D a week ago in first-time blinkers

runners.name: Hugo's Girl
runners.spotlight: Now a 17-race maiden but several good placed efforts, including Navan second (winner has won again since), most recently here a week ago when strong-finishing fourth over 6f, having not had a clear run; this trip her limit, should go well with a clear run and Billy Lee now takes over.
runners.comment: Not clear run when fourth over 6f here last week; Billy Lee takes over and shortlisted

runners.name: Contrary To Law
runners.spotlight: Glimpses of ability in all four maiden runs, both Curragh efforts this term when staying on late over 6f; return to 7f to suit and potential improver entering handicaps.
runners.comment: Return to 7f to suit and potential improver entering handicaps

runners.name: Faoladh
runners.spotlight: Enjoyed a good spell last summer and gained second career win when taking Down Royal handicap over this trip in May; just okay run off 5lb higher at Leopardstown albeit from a wide draw; remains of interest.
runners.comment: Down Royal winner ran okay from bad draw at Leopardstown; remains of interest

runners.name: Unidos
runners.spotlight: Never recovered from tardy start on last month's handicap debut here (6f), last of 12; tongue-tie worn then now discarded and steps up in trip.
