runners.owner: Wong Leung Sau Hing & Eddie Wong Ming Chak

runners.name: Kwai Chung Talents
runners.spotlight: He's proving fairly consistent at 6f without looking ahead of his mark but the handicapper is slowly relenting; should have a race in him.
runners.comment: Has not looked ahead of his mark but the handicapper is slowly relenting
runners.owner: Rotary Club Of Kwai Chung Syndicate

runners.name: King Oberon
runners.spotlight: Won twice here in early part of this season and back in prime form when close third under Zac Purton here last month; another turn looks near.
runners.comment: Back in prime form when close third under Zac Purton here last month; every chance

runners.name: Speedy Power
runners.spotlight: Beaten in trials; has finished closer in each of his official races, last time beaten 3.5l at Sha Tin (5f); should have more to offer but perhaps one for another day from stall 11.
runners.comment: Should have more to offer but perhaps one for another day from stall 11

runners.name: Good Luck Happy
runners.spotlight: In three of his four runs over C&D he's been beaten under 2l, last time only a length off the winner under a positive ride; still lightly raced so may do better again.
runners.comment: In three of his four runs over C&D he's been beaten under 2l; still lightly raced
runners.owner: Siu Chak Wai, Siu Wai Chung & Siu Wing Kin

runners.name: Superb King
runners.spotlight: Now 0-14 but he's produced five competitive performances on the bounce, all here at 5f and mostly 6f; his mark hasn't moved so he's entitled to be in the thick of it once more.
runners.comment: Now 0-14 but he's produced five competitive performances on the bounce

runners.name: E Passion
runners.spotlight: Had plenty of racing in trials but has failed to win one and he'd be a surprise winner on official debut.
runners.comment: Had plenty of racing in trials but has failed to win one

runners.name: Warriors Dream
runners.spotlight: Dual winner in Britain and added a 6f handicap at Sha Tin in March when only 3lb lower; has continued to run well and has form here, but his draw is a negative.
runners.comment: Sha Tin winner in March; has continued to run well and has form here; draw is a negative
runners.owner: Mr & Mrs Stephen Ho Wai Man, F Ho Ka Chun & D Ho Ka Chung

runners.name: Little Monster
runners.spotlight: Reserve; made all from a wide stall at Sha Tin and had excuses next time; his last run was quite underwhelming but he's hard to put a line through him.
runners.comment: Reserve; last run was underwhelming but headed into that race in good form

runners.name: Matzden
runners.spotlight: Won over 7f in New Zealand; 0-7 in Hong Kong but some signs that he's dropping to a realistic mark, for all that he failed to make the anticipated progress returned to 7f (from 6f) last time; drawn wide.
runners.comment: 0-7 in Hong Kong but some signs that he's dropping to a realistic mark

races.race_name: Header Handicap (Class 4) (Course B) (Turf)

runners.name: Thunder Prince
runners.spotlight: Belatedly off the mark in Hong Kong with comfortable C&D win in April, his 22nd attempt, but was below that form on his last two appearances and his favourable draw is not enough to earn him the vote.
runners.comment: Belatedly off the mark in HK over C&D in April but below that form on last two outings
runners.owner: Wilson Chu Kwok Yiu, Paul M F Cheng Et Al

runners.name: Loving Vibes
runners.spotlight: Reserve; has modest 1-26 strike-rate but came second over C&D on last two outing, losing out only by a short head on latter occasion; sports refitted cheekpieces; a possible.
runners.comment: Has modest strike-rate but came second over C&D on last two outings

runners.name: Never Too Soon
runners.spotlight: Didn't fire over 1m last time but went close over that trip in April and can cope with today's drop back to 6f; has form in higher-grade company this season and can't be ruled out.
runners.comment: Didn't fire over 1m last time has form in higher-grade company this season; not ruled out

runners.name: Golden Friendship
runners.spotlight: Runner-up over C&D on two of his last three outings but his only win from 19 starts came in lower-grade company and he's not ideally drawn today; will probably find at least a couple in this field too strong.
runners.comment: Second over C&D on two of last three outings but others have stronger claims all the same
runners.owner: Janet Wong Hoi Shan, John Yuen Se Kit Et Al

runners.name: Young Arrow
runners.spotlight: Placed on consecutive C&D starts in April/May, latterly from stall 12, and was denied a clear run when only fifth here last month; remains of interest but is back in the outside box today.
runners.comment: Knocking on the door since dropped to this grade but has another tough draw

runners.name: Victor The Rapid
runners.spotlight: Now only 1lb higher than when winning over C&D in February but has gone off the boil lately and is poorly drawn; refitted blinkers the headgear of choice today.
runners.comment: C&D winner in February but has gone off the boil lately and is poorly drawn

runners.name: Heroic Vanguard
runners.spotlight: Unexposed after only four runs but yet to build upon his encouraging debut at Sha Tin in March; others preferred.
runners.comment: Unexposed after only four runs but yet to build upon his encouraging debut in March

runners.name: Majestic Delight
runners.spotlight: Dual Class 5 winner this year, latterly when clinging on by a nose over C&D five weeks ago; looks vulnerable in this higher grade, though.
runners.comment: Held on by a nose over C&D last month but looks vulnerable in this higher grade

runners.name: Leading Agility
runners.spotlight: Won readily over C&D in May, his third run for Danny Shum, and ran at least as well when keeping-on third to Forerunner here last month; better drawn today and Zac Purton takes over; could still have more to offer.
runners.comment: Placed off new mark since ready C&D win in May and still quite lighty raced; good chance
runners.owner: Ma Pak Hung & Man Pui Kwan

runners.name: Rainbow Seven
runners.spotlight: Came good with C&D win in February and made the frame here on next two outings; latest run is probably best overlooked (lost action and was pulled up) but wide draw asks quite a lot of him.
runners.comment: Latest run best overlooked; in good form beforehand but wide draw asks a lot of him today
runners.owner: Jason Chow Hei Shing & Chow Yuk Yin

runners.name: Vigor Eye
runners.spotlight: Delivered on earlier promise when scoring narrowly over C&D in April, his sixth start, and quickly rebounded from a poor run when third here last month; not quite so well drawn today but not yet fully exposed; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Came good over C&D in April; placed last month and not yet fully exposed; shortlisted

runners.name: Vermilion Tempest
runners.spotlight: Reserve; outran 33-1 odds when close second at Sha Tin (1m1f) in May but his subsequent run over that C&D was disappointing and he can't be recommended over this trip.
runners.comment: Went close over 1m1f two runs ago but well beaten since and opposable over this trip

runners.name: Bright Day
runners.spotlight: Won from inside stall over C&D in May but was unable to land a telling blow off new mark last month; might find others better handicapped again.
runners.comment: Had good draw when winning here two starts ago; others look better handicapped

runners.name: Forerunner
runners.spotlight: In good form in recent months, most notably when winning over C&D two starts ago; had to settle for fourth off new mark at Sha Tin 17 days ago but is well drawn again here and has each-way claims at least.
runners.comment: In good form in recent months, including C&D win two starts ago; in the mix again
runners.owner: Ng Tai Wing, Anson Or Yiu Wah & Henry Yeung Mun Kin

races.race_name: Breakaway Handicap (Class 3) (Course B) (Turf)

runners.name: Dragon Four Seas
runners.spotlight: Well down the field on first three stable starts but took big step back in right direction and outran huge odds when close fifth at Sha Tin a week ago; now needs to build on that effort.
runners.comment: Took big step back in right direction when close fifth at huge odds last week
runners.owner: Dr Alan Lee Wai Kin, Dr Kelvin Chong Man Yuk Et Al

runners.name: Blue Illusion
runners.spotlight: Scored off 2lb higher over C&D in December but recent efforts have been disappointing; needs to turn a corner.
runners.comment: Scored off 2lb higher over C&D in December but recent efforts have been disappointing

runners.name: Parents' Love
runners.spotlight: Won off reduced mark in 5f Class 4 event at Sha Tin in April and put in good front-running shift when sixth (just behind Dragon Four Seas) over that C&D in this higher grade a week ago but others appeal more all the same.
runners.comment: Ran well from the front a Sha Tin last week but others appeal more all the same
runners.owner: Edmund Ho Kwok Shing, Joe Fong Fu Yuen Et Al

runners.name: Robot Lucky Star
runners.spotlight: Came from off the pace to take fifth from stall 10 over C&D on stable debut a fortnight ago and has the option to revert to more positive tactics from more favourable draw today; interesting.
runners.comment: Respectable fifth over C&D from wide stall on stable debut; much better draw today

runners.name: Casa Of Honor
runners.spotlight: Caused 21-1 surprise over C&D in April, opening his Hong Kong account at the tenth attempt, but safely held since and not easy to predict.
runners.comment: Surprise C&D winner in April but safely held since; not easy to predict

runners.name: Copper Core
runners.spotlight: Ex-Australian 4yo; launched Hong Kong career with three low-key C&D runs and has much tougher draw today; look elsewhere.
runners.comment: Ex-Australian 4yo; launched Hong Kong career with three low-key C&D runs

runners.name: Harmony N Blessed
runners.spotlight: Reserve; nearly caused 65-1 shock over 6f at Sha Tin last month and remains on a good mark but this regressive and inconsistent 9yo was soundly beaten over that C&D on Saturday.
runners.comment: Nearly a shock winner two starts ago but this 9yo is regressive and inconsistent
runners.owner: Cheung Ming Man, Cheung Ying Ho Et Al

runners.name: Dancing Classics
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 5yo who won twice in Class 4 last year (5f/6f); has found things tougher since upped in grade, though, and was safely held at Sha Tin a week ago.
runners.comment: Dual Class 4 winner in 2025 but finding things tougher in this higher grade

runners.name: California Blitz
runners.spotlight: Dual 6f course winner in December and placed on three of his four starts this year; didn't run badly from wide stall when last in action (March) and shows enough early zip to be of interest back at 5f.
runners.comment: Progressive over 6f this season, showing enough early zip to be of interest back at 5f

runners.name: Bunta Baby
runners.spotlight: Progressive 5yo who has collected three C&D wins this season and posted another career-best performance when close third here a fortnight ago; outside draw the obvious negative today, though.
runners.comment: Three C&D wins this season; still in prime form but outside draw a big negative
runners.owner: Chu Tak Wing, Casey Chu Yin Ling & Ronald Chu Tak Wah

runners.name: Duke Atreides
runners.spotlight: 1-4 when based in Australia, the win gained in a 6f maiden; makes Hong Kong debut after ten-month absence, though, and probably best watched.
runners.comment: 6f maiden winner in Australia; makes Hong Kong debut after ten-month absence

runners.name: Candlelight Dinner
runners.spotlight: Made the frame over C&D on last four appearances, most recently when third from stall 1 six weeks ago; not so well drawn this time but new jockey Jerry Chau claims 2lb; probably won't be far away.
runners.comment: Made the frame over C&D on last four appearances; probably won't be far away

runners.name: Young Emperor
runners.spotlight: Reserve; beaten under 1l when dead-heat third over 6f here a fortnight ago but appears to have little margin for error off current mark and is untested over 5f.
runners.comment: Ran well over 6f recently but remains on fairly tough mark and is untested over 5f

runners.name: Eternal Fortune
runners.spotlight: Absent since disappointing 6f run in February but was placed twice over C&D at start of this year and will be dangerous from stall 1 if fully tuned up after his break.
runners.comment: Placed twice over C&D at start of year; dangerous from stall 1 if revved up after break

races.race_name: Hat Trick Handicap (Class 2) (Course B) (Turf)

runners.name: Glittering Legend
runners.spotlight: Close third to Le Zonda off today's mark over C&D last month and an obvious contender if judged on that performance but has very mixed record this year and needs to bounce back quickly from a poor dirt run.
runners.comment: Placed over C&D last month but needs to bounce back quickly from a poor dirt run

runners.name: Pope Cody
runners.spotlight: Largely consistent 4yo who was placed over today's trip at Sha Tin in May; not quite in same form over 1m there last month but recent 2lb drop is helpful; considered each-way.
runners.comment: Largely consistent 4yo who has recently dropped 2lb; considered each-way

runners.name: Pocketing
runners.spotlight: Won 1m2f Group 2 in Australia last April but is yet to be placed after four Hong Kong starts and is seemingly in need of some help from the local handicapper.
runners.comment: Group 2 winner in Australia but yet to be placed after four Hong Kong starts

runners.name: Sword Point
runners.spotlight: Regressive 7yo who ought to have been suited by the return to dirt when safely held in first-time blinkers at Sha Tin 11 days ago; has usual cheekpieces back on for this turf return; revival needed.
runners.comment: Regressive 7yo who needs to stage a revival

runners.name: Fortunate Son
runners.spotlight: Dual 1m course winner this season; split Le Zonda and Glittering Legend when creditable second over C&D last month but is effectively 5lb higher from out of the weights today.
runners.comment: Creditable second over C&D last month but effectively 5lb higher from out of the weights

runners.name: Romantic Thor
runners.spotlight: Progressive 4yo who made all in 1m4f Group 3 handicap at Sha Tin in May and was placed in Group 3 handicap over today's trip there 17 days ago; needs to be taken very seriously.
runners.comment: Placed in Group 3 handicap over this trip at Sha Tin last month; big player
runners.owner: Peter Lau Pak Fai & Suki Tang Xianfang

runners.name: Le Zonda
runners.spotlight: Off the mark in Hong Kong at seventh attempt, finishing strongly from the rear for cosy C&D success last month; it's hard to predict whether this race will pan out in the same way but a recent 7lb rise looks manageable.
runners.comment: Finished strongly from the rear to win cosily over C&D last month; his seventh HK start

runners.name: Liveandletlive
runners.spotlight: Made all over C&D in May and posted another career-best performance when close second here last month; evidently in prime form; respected.
runners.comment: Made all over C&D in May and last month's close second was another career-best effort

runners.name: Joy Of Spring
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D in early part of this season and seemed to have emerged from a dip in form when keeping-on third at Sha Tin (1m2f) last month; remains on a good mark; in the mix.
runners.comment: C&D winner in December; seemingly back in good form last month and remains on good mark
runners.owner: Mr & Mrs Edward Hung & Doris Hung

runners.name: Aerodynamics
runners.spotlight: Gamely made all over 1m2f at Sha Tin in April, his sixth Hong Kong start, and probably bettered that performance when close second over that C&D in May; ran as though something was amiss last time and Zac Purton now jumps ship but he's a contender if back on song.
runners.comment: Ran as though something was amiss last time; earlier form gives him a good shout
runners.owner: Daniel Yeung Ngai & Gwenny Wu Pui Kwan

runners.name: Sky Vino
runners.spotlight: Reserve; gained both wins this year on dirt but was beaten under 1l when fourth off today's mark on turf at Sha Tin (1m) a week ago and will be fine over today's longer trip.
runners.comment: Gained both wins this year on dirt but was close fourth on turf a week ago

runners.name: Awesome Fluke
runners.spotlight: Dual course winner this season (1m1f/1m) but not quite at best on recent outings and still on a fairly tough mark; others have more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Not quite at best lately and still on fairly tough mark; others have more pressing claims

runners.name: Beauty Alliance
runners.spotlight: Placed twice over 1m since winning over that trip here in April and this extra furlong suits him; nudged up 2lb to new career-high mark and has awkward draw to contend with but still enters calculations.
runners.comment: Placed twice over 1m since winning here in April and this extra furlong suits him; player

races.race_name: Penalty Shootout Handicap (Class 3) (Course B) (Turf)

runners.name: Power Koepp
runners.spotlight: Just held on from King Profit to exploit much-reduced mark over C&D last month and remains well handicapped on older form but he's getting long in the tooth and others have more appealing profiles.
runners.comment: Just held on to exploit reduced mark over C&D last month but is not the force of old
runners.owner: Mr & Mrs Simon Ng Kar Ming

runners.name: Wings Of War
runners.spotlight: Posted sound effort when fifth over C&D in April and has another good draw today but this is his first run for 11 weeks ago and he has not been firing on all cylinders this season.
runners.comment: Ran okay here last time and is well drawn again but has not been at his best this season

runners.name: Honest Witness
runners.spotlight: Won consecutive C&D races in March/April and rebounded from a duff effort when second over C&D a fortnight ago; deserted by Zac Purton today and not ideally drawn but still enters calculations.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner this year, and quickly back on song with C&D second a fortnight ago
runners.owner: Arthur Antonio Da Silva, Betty Da Silva & Teresa Da Silva

runners.name: Friends Of Shajing
runners.spotlight: Kept on for fourth over C&D on last month's stable debut and remains on a workable mark but double-digit draw dents his appeal; usual cheekpieces left off.
runners.comment: Ran well when fourth on last month's stable debut but double-digit draw dents appeal

runners.name: Master Champion
runners.spotlight: Made respectable stable debut over 6f at Sha Tin in May but finished last over 5f here a few days later and looks opposable from stall 11.
runners.comment: Made respectable stable debut in May (6f) but finished last soon afterwards (5f)

runners.name: Central Bank
runners.spotlight: Dual 5f winner in Australia; has shown clear promise over that trip in Hong Kong but is yet to be placed after four local runs and has tough draw for this first attempt at 6f.
runners.comment: Has shown local promise over 5f but has tough draw for first 6f attempt

runners.name: Class
runners.spotlight: Reserve; ex-Australian 4yo; yet to make an impact after five Hong Kong starts (7f-1m) and seemingly in need of a drop in grade.
runners.comment: Ex-Australian 4yo; yet to make an impact after five Hong Kong starts (7f-1m)
runners.owner: Jessica Man Yi Lee & Gregory Chi Ho Ho

runners.name: Northern Fire Ball
runners.spotlight: Has twice made all in Class 4 this season (once over C&D) but was reeled in fairly comfortably when back up in this grade last month and, although much better drawn this time, may remain vulnerable at this level.
runners.comment: Front-runner; dual Class 4 winner this season; might be vulnerable at this level

runners.name: King Profit
runners.spotlight: Steadily progressive 5yo who won readily over 5f here in May and lost out only by a short head to Power Koepp over C&D last month; Zac Purton takes the ride today; likely contender.
runners.comment: Ready C&D winner in May and went very close over C&D last month; likely contender again
runners.owner: Mr & Mrs William Y W Lai, Stanley Y C Hong & Sammy Y C Long

runners.name: Target Audience
runners.spotlight: Took form to new level when scoring over C&D last month and is now 2-8 in Hong Kong; latest 8lb rise asks quite a lot of him but he still commands respect.
runners.comment: Took form to new level when scoring over C&D last month and is now 2-8 in Hong Kong

runners.name: Do You Just
runners.spotlight: Came good in Hong Kong at fifth attempt, with C&D win in April, but has been safely held twice since (albeit from wide draws) and needs to kick on again.
runners.comment: Twice safely held since breakthrough Hong Kong win in April; needs to kick on again

runners.name: Thunder Kit
runners.spotlight: Reserve; opened Hong Kong account at Sha Tin in May and was repeatedly denied a clear run when placed off today's mark there 11 days ago; will warrant serious consideration if he gets a run here.
runners.comment: Repeatedly denied clear run when placed off this mark at Sha Tin recently
runners.owner: Ian Chan Yau Nam & Cyrus Chan Sing Kit

runners.name: Aurio
runners.spotlight: Progressive for new stable this season, winning twice (once over C&D) and making the frame six further times; gave another good account when fifth from stall 12 here last month and is much better draw today; ought to be right in the thick of things.
runners.comment: Progressive for new stabe this season and much better drawn than last time; good chance

runners.name: Jubilant Winner
runners.spotlight: Four wins this season, the latest over in April; posted sound effort when fifth over C&D last month but will need to find something extra to overcome this career-high mark.
runners.comment: Four wins this season; still in good form but needs to find extra to overcome this mark
